instructions_to_main_agent.priority_0: Ensure CoreAccessTable & RBAC scoped authorization is intact and patched for Front Group leader scopes and Pastor permissions.
instructions_to_main_agent.priority_1: Implement Consolidated Intake v2 supporting all 4 Entry Doors: Oración e Invasión, Entrada Directa Iglesia, Célula, and Visitor Follow-up queue.
instructions_to_main_agent.priority_2: Build formal Welcome Party (Fiesta de Bienvenida) gate: mandatory mentor qualification evaluation for LBS and historical transfer modal when non-authorized.
instructions_to_main_agent.priority_3: Build explicit Membership Acceptance flow (Carta de Membresía) with authorized verifier, permanent membership code generation, and document issuance trigger.
instructions_to_main_agent.priority_4: Build Front Group (Grupo Frontal) independent structure catalog, scopes, statistics, team history, and process links.
instructions_to_main_agent.priority_5: Build 360 Platform Leadership Promotion modal with configurable criteria check (✓, ⚠, ✕), single-approval by Pastor OR Front Group Leader, without mutating users.role.
instructions_to_main_agent.priority_6: Integrate Retiro completion with Discipleship/Education handoff without purging consolidation log history.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT modify users.role when promoting a person to a ministerial leadership position.
Do NOT delete consolidation history upon mentor transfer or stage completion.
Do NOT use pure #000000 or full transparent headers.
DO include data-testid on all key buttons, inputs, tables, cards, and modal triggers.
DO maintain consistent Ven y Ve 360 styling with blue/gold/green badges, clean white cards, and clear Spectral serif section headers.
